exposure: Attainment of target TSH levels post levothyroxine treatment for subclinical hypothyroidism
outcome: Fetal outcomes (low birth weight, NICU admissions, overall neonatal complications, APGAR score, mode of delivery)
cohort: The study included 168 antenatal women diagnosed with subclinical hypothyroidism.
finding: Attaining target TSH levels after levothyroxine treatment for subclinical hypothyroidism in pregnancy is associated with a decreased risk of overall maternal and neonatal complications.
mod_finding: Mode of delivery was not found to be associated with the attainment of normal TSH levels at the third trimester.
cross-section timing: TSH levels were assessed in the third trimester, and maternal and neonatal outcomes were observed during pregnancy and at birth.
birth_weight: Low birth weight (<2.5 Kg) was an outcome measured in neonates.
